annotations.title: List the countries with travel eSIM plans

description: List the countries and regions you can get a SimoraGo travel eSIM for right now, from the live catalogue, including the Europe and Global plans: for each, the number of plans, the lowest price in USD, the ISO codes of the countries it covers and its page link. Use it when someone asks which countries or destinations are available. For whether a given plan covers a country, use check_coverage.

locale.description: Language for plan names, destination names and page links: en, es, de, fr, pt or he. Default en.
